ideas.title: Zap a friend: static from wool and feathers
ideas.critique: Electrostatics is physics the island has never had: charge you carry, a halo of fluff, a spark set by breakdown, and the friends on the receiving end for once, so it's a prank you can replay. The triboelectric series and the leak rate are table lookups. If the halo and the yelp are animations triggered once charge passes a set level, rather than Coulomb forces on real strands and a real gap field, it falls to a scripted gag.

ideas.title: A thermocouple from the campfire
ideas.critique: Real Seebeck physics fed by the fire's actual temperatures gives the first current on the island, and it links two projects honestly. But the payoff a watcher sees is a needle swinging, and the island has already posted that, and microvolt currents give a tiny deflection with little to do after the first time.

ideas.title: Lightning makes a lodestone
ideas.critique: A dielectric-breakdown leader growing on the GPU around conductors the player placed, iron coming out magnetised, and glass roots dug up afterwards is a big, shareable event with a real race against the storm. The breakdown model is stochastic with tuned constants, the fulgurite is a temperature threshold, and the cloud's charge is most likely a number someone sets. It is a lot of systems for one session's first step.

ideas.title: A living battery in the bay
ideas.nearest: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: A power source with moods, and a field spreading through conducting brine to a friend's feet, is a fresh twist on the cell. The plainest version is one more creature with a pulse timer and fed/calm states written in, and voltages copied from a real ray, which makes it a rig for one case.

ideas.title: Put it out with your beak, for real
ideas.critique: This is round 1's idea again with FLIP water in the beak and granular sand added. Those are real steps: spillage that depends on how Lumi runs gives a crisis loop you replay. It stands or falls on whether the water is really carried and poured by Lumi's head. A fixed beak volume that drains at a set rate would make it the campfire clip again with a flag attached.

ideas.title: A water wheel that makes current
ideas.nearest: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: Lenz braking you can see, a wheel that slows when the load is connected, is the generator step made physical and tied to the island's water, and that is strong. The coil, the wire and the lamp don't exist yet, so this jumps the road. Unless the stream really drives the paddles by drag, it shrinks to a speed slider with induction on top.

ideas.title: Hear the storm coming on a crystal radio
ideas.critique: Sound as an early warning is a new way the world answers the player. The LC resonance is real. The sferics, though, are most likely a crackle whose rate is set from the storm's distance, and nothing radiates or propagates. The goal also depends on boats, rods and storms that the island doesn't have yet.
